sourceDeviationLog.details: The earlier source correction PR #2756 removed a genuine printed Roman I. Direct reinspection on 2026-11-09 of PDF zero-based p.142 confirms 'I. Le pardon accordé'. Source, reader and tests now restore it.
Heading is Vœu à pratiquer in print, not usual Vertu; preserved unchanged.
Final PRIÈRE and ORAISON are printed in full. Day IX collect sa gloire céleste differs from Day I p.115 la gloire céleste; both preserved.
Typographic casing/spacing, line hyphenation and punctuation normalized in stored research text; literal diplomatic fidelity has not been independently certified.
